facts.text: Karnataka sought **₹22,400.58 crore** in drought relief from the Centre; Delhi recorded 1,083 dengue and 355 malaria cases till 31 Oct.

facts.text: PM Modi inaugurated the **Bharat Bovine Breeding and Research Centre (BBBRC)** at **Bhildi** (Banaskantha, Gujarat) and launched ₹14,000-crore projects. He said a urea bag costing ₹3,000 globally reaches farmers for under ₹300, and **DAP** costing ₹5,000+ sells for **₹1,350**.

facts.text: **Central Potato Research Institute (CPRI)** is in **Shimla**; its other coloured varieties are **Kufri Neelkanth** and **Kufri Manik**.
facts.plain: Central Potato Research Institute (CPRI) is in Shimla; its other coloured varieties are Kufri Neelkanth and Kufri Manik.

facts.text: **ICAR-CPRI** developed **Kufri Jamunia**, a purple potato rich in **anthocyanins**: per 100 g, vitamin C 42.75 mg (vs 23.15), zinc 2.28 mg (vs 0.28), iron 3.22 mg (vs 0.57). Notified in Nov 2024; matures in about **90 days**; susceptible to **late blight** (*Phytophthora infestans*).

facts.text: **PM-KISAN** (launched Feb 2019 at Gorakhpur) gives **₹6,000 a year** in three instalments of ₹2,000 by direct benefit transfer.
facts.plain: PM-KISAN (launched Feb 2019 at Gorakhpur) gives ₹6,000 a year in three instalments of ₹2,000 by direct benefit transfer.

facts.text: PM **Narendra Modi** released the **24th instalment** of **PM-KISAN** in Gujarat on 30 Oct: over **₹18,690 crore** to **9.34 crore** farmers.

facts.text: Rajasthan paid about **₹345 crore** in pending crop insurance claims to farmers in nine districts. **PMFBY** (2016): farmer premium **2%** for kharif, **1.5%** for rabi, **5%** for commercial/horticultural crops.
